summary: Iter 524 Punch-Time Photo Capture: 15/15 backend tests PASS, all frontend E2E flows verified. Punch-log list returns photo_status field (captured/pending/missing) and photo filter works; seeded record zk_1ecabfb2c771 correctly returns photo_status=captured with has_photo=true. Photo JSON + photo.jpg endpoints work (query-token auth confirmed; missing token → 401/403). PDF export valid with/without include_photos=1 (valid %PDF header, size grows with embedded images). Reconciliation totals are consistent (received+pending+missing == total_punches; seed guarantees ≥1 captured). Retry-match returns {ok, scanned, matched}, tolerates empty queue, requires auth. XLSX regression OK. Frontend: Punch Log Report shows Sync from machines / Photo Sync / PDF / PDF+Photos / Download Excel header buttons; Punch Photo filter dropdown offers All/Available/Pending/Missing. Photo Sync screen shows all 6 metric cards (Total Punches=1, Photos Received=1, Pending=0, Missing=0, Failed=0, Parked=0 for Kankani Aug 2026 window), coverage bar (100%), date + firm + Apply filters, and Retry Photo Sync produces 'Re-scanned 0 parked photos · matched 0 to punches'. Sidebar entry defined in AdminWebShell.tsx line 139 (/photo-sync).

issues: Punch Photo column appears far right of a wide table; users may need horizontal scroll to see thumbnails. Consider making it sticky or reordering.

react_native_issues.issue: photo-sync.tsx uses a raw HTML <select> guarded by Platform.OS === 'web' for the Firm filter. Native (iOS/Android via Expo Go) will render NO firm filter at all. Reference: /app/frontend/app/photo-sync.tsx:180-193

Runtime warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' — surfacing on both screens, not introduced by iter 524 but present.

action_items: (optional) Add native (mobile) fallback for the Firm dropdown in /photo-sync — currently only web renders the select.
(optional) Consider making the 'Punch Photo' column sticky or moving it left so thumbnails are visible without horizontal scroll on the Punch Log Report.
critical_code_review_comments: punch_logs.py is 1004 lines — nearing the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting PDF/XLSX exporters into helper modules.
retry-match scans up to 2000 photos per call; a very large parked queue may need pagination or a background task. Attendance ingestion is not affected.
